sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition Nos. 2108, 2111, 2115, 2116, 2248,
 2252, 2272, 2361, 2850 and 2870 Of 2020
Common Order:

-
All these petitions are filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking quash of the crimes registered against them for the offences punishable under sections 273 and 188 IPC and under Sections 57, 58 r/w 26 and 30 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 (for short,
'the FSS Act').
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.

3. When the matters are taken up for hearing, both the learned counsel for the petitioners in all these petitions and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that these matters are squarely covered by earlier decisions of this court, whereunder criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners therein based on similar set of facts are quashed by this court, as not maintainable.
They have also produced the copies of the earlier orders passed by this court in Crl.P.No.100 of 2020, dated 08.01.2020 and Crl.P.No.4876 of 2019, dated 22.08.2019.

4. As can be seen from the aforesaid two orders produced by the learned counsel for the petitioners,
it is evident that criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners therein based on similar set of facts and section of law, were quashed by this court on various technical grounds and on the ground that tobacco product would not come within the definition of the food defined under Section 3(j) of FSS Act and as such, police are not authorized to register the crime.

5. Therefore, in view of the fact that this Court has already quashed the criminal proceedings initiated against the other accused based on similar set of facts, the petitioners herein who are similarly placed are also entitled for quash of the criminal proceedings launched against them in all these petitions.
6. In the result, all these Criminal Petitions are allowed.
The criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners in all these petitions, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
